name: dsh-hub-desktop
description: DSH Hub — 多实例 dsh 桌面管理中心:本地 / SSH / 远程认证实例统一管理
author: xbzbing

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.dist: pnpm electron:prepare && pnpm bundle:npm && pnpm bundle:pnpm && pnpm build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm electron:prepare && pnpm bundle:npm && pnpm bundle:pnpm && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:zip: pnpm electron:prepare && pnpm bundle:npm && pnpm bundle:pnpm && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac zip --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm electron:prepare && pnpm bundle:npm && pnpm bundle:pnpm && pnpm build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:win:local: pnpm bundle:npm && pnpm bundle:pnpm && pnpm build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never -c.electronDist=
